meta.name: image-upscaling
meta.description: Upscale and enhance images with Real-ESRGAN, Thera, Topaz, FLUX Upscaler via inference.sh CLI. Models: Real-ESRGAN, Thera (any size), FLUX Dev Upscaler, Topaz Image Upscaler. Use for: enhance low-res images, upscale AI art, restore old photos, increase resolution. Triggers: upscale image, image upscaler, enhance image, increase resolution, real esrgan, ai upscale, super resolution, image enhancement, upscaling, enlarge image, higher resolution, 4k upscale, hd upscale

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提升图片分辨率并增强画质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把模糊小图变成高清大图。
copy.tagline_en: Upscale and enhance image resolution and quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn blurry small images into high-resolution ones.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行调用多种模型来放大和增强图片，例如提升低分辨率图片、修复老照片、增加分辨率。
howto.when: 当你要求放大图片、增强图片、增加分辨率，或提到“upscale image”、“enhance image”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请放大这张图片到4K分辨率。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Topaz 等模型处理图片。

say.text: 帮我增强这张低分辨率照片。
修复并放大这张老照片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can upscale and enhance images via command line using models like Real-ESRGAN, Thera, Topaz, and FLUX Upscaler, for tasks such as improving low-res images, upscaling AI art, restoring old photos, and increasing resolution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to upscale, enhance, or increase resolution of an image, or mention keywords like 'upscale image', 'enhance image', 'super resolution', etc.

say_en.note: Claude will use Topaz or other models to process.
Claude will call Real-ESRGAN to improve quality.

say_en.text: Restore and upscale this old photo.
say_en.note: Claude will use upscalers to recover details and increase resolution.
